data.name: Jeemaat
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word ‘Jamaa’ah’, which means ‘a community or group of believers’. This name represents the idea of coming together in faith and unity. In Islamic history, the term ‘Jamaa’ah’ was used to refer to the collective body of Muslims, united in their beliefs and practices.
data.spiritual_meaning: Bringing people together in faith and unity
data.numerology_meaning: People with the name Jeemaat tend to be highly independent and individualistic. They are free-spirited, creative, and are not afraid to take risks. They are able to adapt easily to new situations, and they have a strong desire to be their own boss. They are also highly intelligent and intuitive, and they have a strong sense of inner wisdom.

in_arabic.name: جِيمَات
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم مشتق من الجماعة والجمعية، يدل على الاجتماع والتواصل الحسن بين الناس، ويدل أيضًا على الائتلاف والتعاون، كما ورد في القرآن الكريم في سياق الإلف والائتلاف بين الناس، ويحمل دلالة روحية على أهمية التآخي والتواصل في المجتمع الإسلامي.

in_hindi.meaning: एक सुंदर समूह एक अच्छा समूह
in_hindi.long_meaning: यह नाम अरबी मूल से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है 'جماعة' (जमाआ) से लिया गया है, जो समूह या समुदाय को दर्शाता है, भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इसका उपयोग आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है, जो इस्लामी समाज में एकता और सौहार्द की प्रतीक है।

in_english.name: Jeemaat
in_english.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'جَمَاعَة' (jama'ah), meaning a group, assembly, or community, this name signifies unity, harmony, and togetherness, reflecting the Islamic value of communal harmony and mutual support, with roots in Quranic principles of cooperation and collective responsibility.
